catalog.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_commitment_sales_order_unique ON public.credit_commitments USING btree (sales_order_id) WHERE (sales_order_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_commitments_pkey ON public.credit_commitments USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_commitments_source_type_source_key_key ON public.credit_commitments USING btree (source_type, source_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quotations_pkey ON public.quotations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quotations_quotation_number_key ON public.quotations USING btree (quotation_number)
CREATE INDEX receivable_obligations_branch_due_id_idx ON public.receivable_obligations USING btree (branch_id, due_date, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receivable_obligations_delivery_verification_id_key ON public.receivable_obligations USING btree (delivery_verification_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receivable_obligations_opening_source_id_key ON public.receivable_obligations USING btree (opening_source_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receivable_obligations_pkey ON public.receivable_obligations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receivable_obligations_service_verification_id_key ON public.receivable_obligations USING btree (service_verification_id)

queries.name: quotation_list
queries.sql: select id, quotation_number, revision_number, state, total_vnd, customer_name_snapshot, site_name_snapshot, expires_at, created_at from public.quotation_read where branch_id = '51397be5-b5f0-0a20-8c54-0a3af0e74716' order by created_at desc, id desc limit 26

queries.name: receivable_customer_lookup
queries.sql: select id, original_amount_vnd, due_date from public.receivable_obligations where customer_id = '55c87be7-5de7-83cb-31d2-5798f97b3faa' order by id

queries.name: credit_customer_aggregate
queries.sql: select coalesce(sum(amount_vnd - consumed_vnd - released_vnd), 0)::text as committed_vnd from public.credit_commitments where customer_id = '55c87be7-5de7-83cb-31d2-5798f97b3faa'

queries.name: customer_credit_exposure
queries.sql: select customer_id, branch_id, credit_limit_vnd::text, receivable_vnd::text, committed_vnd::text, exposure_vnd::text, available_vnd::text from public.customer_credit_exposure where customer_id = '55c87be7-5de7-83cb-31d2-5798f97b3faa'
